reason: Pay-when-happy takes the money risk away, fair play, but the real cost for me is time, and I've already had web blokes chasing me this month. A guy in Kuwait with no UK clients and a demo café site doesn't make me confident he'll handle it all without me babysitting it, so I'd park it rather than start.
objection: Who is this guy really, and what's the catch? If it goes sideways I'm stuck chasing someone in another time zone over WhatsApp, and 'honest review in return' tells me I'm the guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real UK business he's done a site for that I could actually ring or visit, plus a quick video call where he shows me exactly what he'd do and that I won't have to lift a finger.
